title: nomibench: calibrated, discoverability-matched benchmarks of gene nominations against genetic causal support
description: Tests whether a set of nominated genes carries more genetic causal support (for example SMR/HEIDI support) than its genes' discoverability predicts. Propensity-score Firth estimator with penalised-likelihood inference; secondary and doubly robust estimators; estimand-targeted plasmode calibration; discoverability-matched negative-control gene sets; genomic-block bootstrap; pre-specified decision rules. Includes the reproduction scripts for paper 1 and its frozen aggregate outputs (no gene-level data).
